model: two-way weakly nonlinear waveguide coupled to Adachi-Sato 2D lips

primary_book.title: The Science of Brass Instruments
primary_book.linear_geometry: Webster equation / area scattering, printed pp.148-149; inherited geometry and mouthpiece data are detailed in sources.json

time_domain_reference.title: Time-domain numerical modeling of brass instruments including nonlinear wave propagation, viscothermal losses, and lips vibration
time_domain_reference.use: Counterpropagating weakly nonlinear waves, causal diffusive wall losses, time-domain lip feedback. Our area-junction waveguide and Adachi-Sato 2D lips are not an exact reproduction of that paper's implementation.

implementation_assumptions: Independent Burgers self-distortion of forward and backward acoustic waves; cross-wave quadratic mixing is neglected.
Area changes scatter waves at every junction; reflected waves subsequently propagate nonlinearly back to the lips.
Eight positive diffusive wall-loss terms; real characteristic impedance rho*c/S; passive RL bell termination.
20 Hz causal mean estimate separates average blowing flow from acoustic self-distortion.
Book graph digitisation and inferred mouthpiece dimensions are unchanged from the previous versions.
Per-note lip spring frequency and equilibrium opening were adjusted; G4 blowing pressure was reduced to 6000 Pa for the desired register.
Weak period doubling remains in G4; its radiated 196 Hz component is about 32 dB below the 392 Hz carrier.
